name: std::chrono::operator<<(std::chrono::gps_time)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT, class Traits, class Duration>

std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits> &

operator<<(std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits> &os,

    const std::chrono::gps_time<Duration> &tp);

intro: Outputs tp into the stream os, as if by os << std::format(os.getloc(), STATICALLY-WIDEN("{:L%F %T}"), tp), where STATICALLY_WIDEN<CharT>("{:L%F %T}") is "{:L%F %T}" if CharT is char, and L"{:L%F %T}" if CharT is wchar_t.
